tum librum. fumtus & reditus publici. 1. Reg.4.ver.7.20.25.
XI. Curatio reip. est, qua sanantur morbi
ciuiles, qui male afficiunt rempublicam. Hic duo
sunt obseruanda: quinam videl. morbi remp. infestent,
& quomodo illi morbi curentur. Ad primum quod atti-
net, certum & ratum esse debet, politiam mutari posse, &
cles.4.verf.14. Hoc diligenter inculcandum est regibus &
principibus, qui interdum sibi persuadent solium & regi-
men suum fore aeternum, vt in Pharaone & Nebucadne-
zare videre est. Deinde morbi, qui politias euertunt, aut
saltem mutationem illis adferunt, sunt atrocia peccata,
quæ attrahunt poenas varias. Peccata hic summatim sunt
contemtus Dei. 1. Sam.12. ver.17.27. Exod.8.v.9.c.14. Iof.24.
c.28.verf.15.16. seditio ciuium inter se, siue bellum ciuile. 2.

page.notes: Left margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are printed line counts and are given at their lines. The scan is blurred at several points: the "s" and "f" forms are read as s, and the reference numbers in the second paragraph (for example "Gen.47.verf.21", "Esa.60") are copied as seen but may contain small misreadings. The lines at the very end of the page are faint. Marked "f. 21." at lower right is read as a signature.
